notes.title: - Dino Run 2 Progress Update -
notes.notes: [p]Hello All,[/p][p align="start"]Time for another update regarding our progress on [b]Dino Run 2[/b]![/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44751000/16340a75fdcc63409c902a52a10b5f4190094efc.png"][/img][/p][h3][b]Kickstarter Campaign[/b][/h3][p align="start"]Things are rolling along well, and we've reached four of our funding goals so far. If you want to throw it some support, [url="https://steamcommunity.com/linkfilter/?u=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.kickstarter.com%2Fprojects%2Fpixeljam%2Fthe-dino-run-2-early-access-campaign%3Fref%3D9aoxr8" style="button"]Click here to check it out[/url]. Next funding goal will unlock the [b]Jungle Homestead[/b], which adds a new biome and placeable objects to your domestic endeavors in the Dino Run universe:[/p][h3][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44751000/77fe35b9fb49ca9a525ff86013349858309fcf3d.png"][/img][/h3][h3][b]Multiplayer Sandbox[/b][/h3][p align="start"]We're weeks away from launching [b]Pivots[/b], which will allow you to pin any object to the world and rotate around it. [b]All backers of the Kickstarter campaign get immediate access to the sandbox.[/b] With pivots you can start to make your prehistoric engineering ideas come to life:[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44751000/e51365e241fa5fc03758ed1eaa005922b59e07d6.gif"][/img][/p][h3][b]What's Next[/b][/h3][list][*][p][b]Level Generator:[/b] Define parameters and "roll" a level until you like the way it looks, then enter it and start adding on objects and decorations.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Doomwall 1.0:[/b] a basic version of the doom to add the necessary urgency that Dino Runners demand...[/p][/*][/list][p align="start"][/p][p align="start"]Many more of our future tasks can be seen on the ROADMAP in the [b][url="https://steamcommunity.com/linkfilter/?u=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.kickstarter.com%2Fprojects%2Fpixeljam%2Fthe-dino-run-2-early-access-campaign%3Fref%3D9aoxr8"]kickstarter campaign[/url].[/b] We're going to keep on with it until it's ready to launch into Early Access in 2026. Thanks again for the patience and support![/p][p align="start"][/p][p align="start"][i]-Miles @ Pixeljam[/i][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44751000/1d767de6726e7a617b7c68b76154f13781d1a1d2.png"][/img][/p]

notes.title: Sandbox Mega-Update!
notes.notes:
Hello all,

We recently made a major update to the Sandbox Alpha, available to all current supporters:

[b]Raptor:[/b]
[list]
[*] Added tail whap ability 
[*] Improved raptor collisions
[*] Added several new idle animations
[*] Raptor's feet now adapt to terrain while idle
[*] Raptor now blinks procedurally
[*] Added crouching
[*] Added pounce animation
[*] Added vanity station for changing the raptor's color palette and patterns
[/list]

[b]Sandbox:[/b]
[list]
[*] Added several new placeable objects
[*] Added several decorative placeables (Ferns, trees, etc.)
[*] Added a flavor selector for placeables (bouncy, icy, etc)
[*] Added palette swapping and flavor variations to almost all placeable objects
[/list]

[b]Misc:[/b]
[list]
[*] Expanded the start cave into a new sanctuary
[*] Added a debug console
[*] Dragonflies now come in several colors
[*] Supporters list is updated automatically
[/list]

Check the video for what this actually looks like: [url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=YXM-fPwW228]https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=YXM-fPwW228[/url]

We're steadily working towards bringing this (and much more) over to Early Access sometime in 2025.

[i]-Miles @ Pixeljam[/i]
